facts.fact: SSGI signed an agreement on 13 December 2025 with Arba Minch, Jinka and Wolayita Sodo to start preparing and implementing a digital addressing system (eDAS).
SSGI's Deputy Director General says eDAS is already being practically implemented in 73 cities across Ethiopia.
SSGI's Deputy Director General says eDAS integrates digital identification (Fayda), postal and parcel delivery services and other digital platforms.
